- make verify (JIRA_URL/JIRA_USER/JIRA_API_TOKEN unset), 13:52-14:46 PST: exit 0. Default tier 20847 passed, 29 skipped; integration tier 202 passed, 2 skipped.
- Pushed as Gerrit change 3337, WIP, hashtag rebar-session-a85e3cd3-9e61-4f25-9de4-cd740e853b4d. HOLD: this epic must not land in release 0.14.1; the change stays WIP until the operator posts RELEASED, then lands at LLM-Review +1 / Verified +1 / 0 unresolved comments.
- The ticket closes only after 3337 merges.
